name: Atrioxhosting
notes:
Atrioxhosting is a Netherlands based hosting provider focused primarily on game server hosting and the infrastructure behind it.

Our goal is to build a modern hosting platform that combines high performance infrastructure with reliable, accessible and easy to use services. We continuously develop our platform, from the underlying server and network infrastructure to our billing, client and game management systems.

Game hosting is at the core of Atrioxhosting, making low latency, network stability and consistent performance especially important to us. As our platform grows, we continue to expand our infrastructure and network connectivity to provide a better experience for our customers.

We believe in continuously improving and building for the long term, both at the service and infrastructure level.

For network, interconnection or peering inquiries, please use the contact information listed on PeeringDB.
